affected_boundaries: managed-worktree classification to task-scoped archive capability

observed_behavior: A worker could not complete ARCHIVE_WORKTREE because Codex reported that its host-managed checkout was not attached to that task.
expected_behavior: The coordinator retires every eligible managed campaign checkout through a supported operation whose authority follows the worker session rather than an optional task artifact.
causal_mechanism: The policy treated managed-worktree provenance as proof that the destination chat owned an archive artifact, but Codex thread handoff can create a managed checkout without attaching such an artifact to that chat.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A lifecycle action selected a capability from a broad resource classification without proving the narrower ownership precondition required by that capability.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The resource is valid and managed, but the archive API authorizes only artifacts attached to the calling task, so cleanup cannot begin from the worker chat.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: The retirement operation is authorized by the exact worker session and managed-checkout association represented by the cleanup action.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Carry the session in ARCHIVE_WORKTREE, run project cleanup in that worker, then have the coordinator use current-host thread handoff to move the same session out of the managed checkout and verify the old path disappeared.

applicability_conditions: A host distinguishes managed resource provenance from task-local artifact attachment.
A coordinator must retire a worker checkout created or moved by session handoff.
known_non_matches: Restore of a proven archived artifact still uses the artifact-specific restore operation.
A stale abandoned slot with no campaign session uses project-owned fenced worktree reclamation.
confirmation_evidence: Codex rejected the worker archive request with 'This worktree is not attached to the current task.' while the checkout remained present and clean.
The existing live-host UAT record documents the same failure for a handoff-created worktree.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: historical cleanup actions gain the bound session required for coordinator handoff
tests/plan-execution-policy.test.js: campaign coordinator skill requires current-host thread handoff
